mechanism: Prochlorperazine potentiates the hypotensive effects of hydrochlorothiazide through additive vasodilation and orthostatic hypotension risk; both agents can cause hypokalemia and electrolyte imbalances.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely, assess orthostatic vital signs, and monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium); educate patient on postural precautions and advise rising slowly from seated/lying positions.
